admission.justification: The always-on texts of eight roles, the shared every-role text and the launch assignment all carry pointers, so one statement keeps a tool from being named only behind an unopened detail file.

applicability: Every always-on role text and operation text composed into a role capsule.
conditions: The text asks for an action done with an Agents Remember tool, or points to a detail section that does.
exclusions: A pointer whose detail involves no tool, which stays unchanged.

evidence: notes/reports/260928-MIK-L60-evidence/partC/pointers.md (every pointer marked) and rendered capsules in notes/reports/260928-MIK-L60-evidence/partC/

statement: An always-on instruction that asks for an action done with an AR tool, or points to a detail section that does, names the tool in the pointing sentence; every always-on role text and operation text composed into capsules was examined pointer by pointer.
